name: Knowing Jesus
overview: Scripture reveals that knowing Jesus is central to understanding God’s unique and eternal nature, as He is the Word who was with God and is God from the beginning (John 1:1; Isaiah 43:10). Jesus is presented as the only way to the Father, offering eternal life to all who believe in Him, the bread of life sent from heaven (John 3:16; John 6:50; John 14:6). This knowledge calls for a personal commitment, as Jesus challenges His followers to remain with Him or turn away (John 6:67).
